title: Every Layer Counts: An Exponential $L_2$ Depth Hierarchy for ReLU Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.23877v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We prove a depth hierarchy for ReLU neural networks in which every additional ReLU layer can save exponentially many neurons. For every $\ell\geq 3$, a globally $[0,1]$-valued, $1$-Lipschitz function is realized by a depth-$\ell$ network of width $\mathcal{O}(d^4)$, whereas every depth-$(\ell-1)$ network with unrestricted weights and width at most $2^d/[2d(\ell-2)]$ has squared $L_2$ error at least $1/24$ under an absolutely continuous distribution. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first exponential separation for ReLU networks between two fixed depths whose shallower depth is at least $3$, and the first exponential hierarchy across all adjacent fixed depths. The lower bound also immediately yields the corresponding hierarchy for exact computation. Moreover, the case $\ell=3$ gives a compactly supported depth-$3$-versus-depth-$2$ separation with unrestricted shallow-network weights, answering a question raised by Safran, Eldan,

translated_title: 每一层都至关重要：ReLU网络的指数级$L_2$深度层级结构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23877v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们证明了ReLU神经网络的一个深度层级结构，其中每增加一个ReLU层就能指数级地节省神经元数量。对于每个$\ell\geq 3$，一个全局取值于$[0,1]$的1-Lipschitz函数可以通过宽度为$\mathcal{O}(d^4)$的深度$\ell$网络实现，而任何宽度至多为$2^d/[2d(\ell-2)]$、权重不受限制的深度$(\ell-1)$网络，在绝对连续分布下，其平方$L_2$误差至少为$1/24$。据我们所知，这是首次针对ReLU网络在两个固定深度之间（其中较浅深度至少为3）的指数级分离，也是首次在相邻固定深度之间建立指数级层级结构。下界也直接产生了精确计算对应的层级结构。此外，$\ell=3$的情况给出了一个紧支撑的深度3对深度2的分离，且浅层网络权重不受限制，回答了Safran、Eldan提出的一个问题。
tldr: 本研究首次证明了ReLU网络中每增加一层可指数级节省神经元，建立了固定深度至少为3的相邻深度间的指数级L2误差层级结构。
en_tdlr: This work establishes the first exponential depth hierarchy for ReLU networks between fixed depths of at least 3, showing that each additional layer can exponentially reduce the required width.
